items.html: *And we shall now explain the matter of the knot of the Tefillin of the head — what its matter is. I have already informed you of the matter of Jacob, who married Rachel and Leah, and he is the aspect of ZA, who has two wives, Leah and Rachel — one above and one below. For Rachel begins from his chest and below, and Leah begins from behind his Daat until his chest.
